given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser selects an archived product version
given_when_then.then: The system disables all edit fields and prevents the submission of an update request

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser selects a non-archived product version
given_when_then.then: The system enables edit fields and allows the submission of an update request

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry that is in an archived state
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating that the entry is archived

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits a new product entry with all required fields filled
given_when_then.then: The system creates the new entry, assigns it as the current version, and displays a success message

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry with a missing required field
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the missing field

success_criteria: The system prevents editing of a product version when its status is archived.
The system disables all input fields for an archived product version.
The system rejects update requests for archived product versions.
The system displays an error message when an update request fails due to an archived state.
The system displays an error message when an update request fails due to missing required fields.
The system retains previous versions and marks them as archived when a new version is published.
